question: Which customer has the highest average monthly change in payment amounts? Provide the customer's full name.
sql:
-- Verify: 487 has 3 months, 2 changes (42.87 and 22.03), average = (42.87 + 22.03) / 2 = 32.45
-- That matches. Let me also double-check by running the full query with customer names to confirm
WITH monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT customer_id, 
           date_trunc('month', payment_date) as payment_month,
           SUM(amount) as monthly_total
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date)
),
with_changes AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           payment_month,
           monthly_total,
           monthly_total - LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as monthly_change
    FROM monthly_totals
)
SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name,
       AVG(wc.monthly_change) as avg_monthly_change
FROM with_changes wc
JOIN customer c ON wc.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE wc.monthly_change IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
ORDER BY avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 5
